item.title: The invisible interview: How AI is reshaping employer brand
item.description: AI has inserted itself into the earliest stages of the job search, building narratives about employers most CHROs have never looked at. The post The invisible interview: How AI is reshaping employer brand appeared first on HR Executive.

item.title: Only one major health insurer analyzed earns positive trust score
item.description: "Insurers risk sleepwalking into a financial crisis by neglecting customer trust," says Adoreboard CEO Chris Johnston. The post Only one major health insurer analyzed earns positive trust score appeared first on HR Executive.

item.title: Will working from home become a protected right?
item.description: Australia's Victoria is legislating work-from-home rights. The move exposes compliance gaps that U.S. HR leaders haven't had to solve…yet. The post Will working from home become a protected right? appeared first on HR Executive.

item.title: Trump immigration policies creating talent challenges for employers
item.description: New immigration policies are among the factors prompting companies to report workforce staffing challenges. The post Trump immigration policies creating talent challenges for employers appeared first on HR Executive.

item.title: Why abandoning disparate impact protections is a disaster in the age of AI
item.description: The loss of disparate impact protections removes one of the only tools workers have to challenge discrimination caused by AI. The post Why abandoning disparate impact protections is a disaster in the age of AI appeared first on HR Executive.

item.title: Nearly 9 in 10 workers report satisfaction with employer sponsored health coverage
item.description: Health insurance ranks as the most important workplace benefit, with 68% of respondents identifying it as their top benefit. The post Nearly 9 in 10 workers report satisfaction with employer sponsored health coverage appeared first on HR Executive.

item.title: Middle East crisis puts Amazon, Google and Nvidia’s duty of care to the test
item.description: "In times of geopolitical uncertainty, attempting to predict events is less important than preparing for rapid change," says Georg Winter, CEO of risk advisory firm GrECo. The post Middle East crisis puts Amazon, Google and Nvidia’s duty of care to the test appeared first on HR Executive.

item.title: Oracle’s potential mass layoff signals an AI trade-off
item.description: Oracle is reportedly weighing cuts of up to 30,000 employees to fund AI data center expansion. Here's what HR leaders need to watch. The post Oracle’s potential mass layoff signals an AI trade-off appeared first on HR Executive.

item.title: From busywork to better work: Amplify manager results with agentic AI
item.description: As organizations increase managers' spans of control, they risk losing significant performance; yet, agentic AI can transform that challenge into an opportunity. The post From busywork to better work: Amplify manager results with agentic AI appeared first on HR Executive.

item.title: Trump Accounts move forward as Treasury issues proposed rules
item.description: The IRS and Treasury Department last week unveiled details on the new Trump Accounts, but guidance on employer involvement remains pending. The post Trump Accounts move forward as Treasury issues proposed rules appeared first on HR Executive.
